profile.caption: Transforming software development with artificial intelligence
profile.bio1: Hi, I'm Andres Ramos, a software developer with more than 5 years of experience, focused mainly on backend development. In early 2026 I started moving toward building software products, integrating artificial intelligence into my work and actively sharing what I learn with the community.
profile.bio2: I was born in a very small town and currently live in Pitalito, Huila, a place known for its high-quality coffee and its coffee culture. Outside of technology, I enjoy lifting weights, listening to rock, and reading about philosophy.
profile.bio3: Throughout my career I have moved from building and integrating software components to taking part in the full product lifecycle: from analyzing problems and designing solutions to implementation, architecture, deployment, and technical coordination.
profile.siteBody: This page is my public log and personal space. Here I will share technical notes, reflections on product development, guides, courses, projects, and images of what I am working on. It is a living space that will evolve alongside my professional and personal growth.
profile.stackIntro: Technologies and tools I want to learn, explore, and keep adding to my professional work.

software.title: Software development
software.description: Building modular, maintainable, and well-structured solutions, with attention to code quality, how components are organized, and the technical decisions that make systems easier to evolve.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.description: Exploring how AI can extend what software can do, help solve problems, improve development processes, and open new possibilities for building products.

products.title: Product development
products.description: Taking part in how ideas evolve, from identifying a problem and understanding its needs to designing and building useful solutions that create value.

learning.title: Continuous learning
learning.description: Going deeper into new technologies, investigating how things work, experimenting with different tools, and turning what I learn into practical experience.

r5.description: During my first years I worked in R5's insurance area, where I took part in building automations, scripts, and integrations. I also provided internal and external technical support to different teams and organizations, including Bancolombia and AXA Seguros, supporting SOAT sales on the platform.

items.support: Internal and external technical support: handling requests, analyzing errors, and resolving incidents related to operations.
items.soat: SOAT sales: supporting the sales processes running on R5's system.
items.integrations: Third-party integrations: building and maintaining connections with financial institutions, insurers, and other providers.
items.services: Service integration: adding new insurers and payment gateways.
items.automation: Process automation: writing scripts and tools to streamline operational tasks.
items.fraud: Fraud prevention: contributing to tools for fraud management and restricted-customer lists.

nova.description: I currently work at Novadynamics, helping build a technology solution for virtual contact centers. The platform brings together chat, telephony, management tools, and artificial intelligence so the operation lives in one place.

items.requirements: Requirements analysis: identifying needs and defining technical solutions.
items.databases: Databases: designing, structuring, and managing data models.
items.development: Software development: implementing and evolving platform features.
items.ai: Artificial intelligence: building and implementing AI capabilities inside the software.
items.architecture: Architecture: taking part in technical decisions about how solutions are designed and organized.
items.deployment: Deployment: putting applications and new features into operation.
items.tooling: Tools and processes: building internal utilities and improving the team's workflows.
